subject: Post-call recap: buying roles, procurement path & PO timing
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightcore.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12 14:03 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: buying roles, procurement path & PO timing

Hi Tom — great speaking earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and agreed next steps so we’re aligned as you engage procurement: 

1) Buying roles we identified (please confirm):
   - Economic buyer: Priya Mehta (Head of Data & Platform)
   - Procurement/finance contact: Oliver Grant (AP / Vendor Intake)
   - Security reviewer: internal security team (TBD contact)

2) Decision criteria you shared:
   - Predictable unit cost at 99th percentile latencies
   - Ability to deploy in VPC with customer-managed keys
   - SOC 2 evidence and audit log retention for 12 months

3) Procurement/onboarding items we’ll prepare:
   - PO onboarding checklist (attached)
   - Draft SOW template (attached)
   - Standard SOC 2 snapshot + evidence index

4) Timeline: you mentioned procurement usually takes 3–4 weeks once legal and finance have docs. You’ll confirm whether a temporary P-card/credit approach is preferred for pilot vs PO.

Please confirm the procurement contact (Oliver?) and whether Priya will be the final signer. I’ll loop in our Sales Ops to prep the packet once you confirm.

Next steps:
- Tom: confirm procurement contact and whether we can share SOC 2 materials with your security reviewer (reply)
- Lauren/Aditya: prepare the onboarding packet and a suggested pilot PO template
- Ben: evaluate potential pricing guardrails for a 90-day pilot to protect their unit economics

Thanks — I’ll aim to have the packet to you by EOD Friday once you confirm contacts.

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), Redwood_SOW_template.pdf (PDF stub)

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: buying roles, procurement path & PO timing

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clear notes. Correct on roles: Priya is the economic buyer and will sign for pilot value up to $75k. Oliver is our vendor intake owner and will handle PO routing and invoice center.

A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Security reviewer will be Maya R. (cc’d? I’ll introduce once I confirm her availability) — we need to see SOC 2 and encryption/KMS details first.
- For the pilot we likely do a PO rather than a P-card to make finance happy; Oliver will confirm required PO wording (vendor legal name & remit).
- Target timing: we can aim to execute PO within 2–3 weeks if we have the SOW and SOC 2 artifacts this week.

I’ve looped Priya and Oliver on this thread. Oliver — can you confirm invoice remit and PO contact info so Lauren can populate the checklist?

— Tom
